data.title: What run club leads ask us.
items: Can my free runs stay free?
Yes. Catch charges nothing on runs you don’t charge for, every week. The 5% fee applies only to paid tickets, and never passes ₹10,000 in a month.
Do runners need to download an app?
No. Runners book on your page and check in at the meeting point. Live moments open in their phone’s browser.
Can we keep our WhatsApp group?
Yes, and most clubs do. Keep chatting there and post your Catch link for sign-ups, payments and pods.
Every booking brings a pace. Catch builds pods of six to eight at a similar pace and spreads newcomers so no pod is all strangers. You can move anyone before the run.
Can I charge for some runs and not others?
Yes. Each event has its own price, so a free social run and a paid coached session can sit side by side.
Can I bring my runners across from another tool?
Yes. Import your list from any tool. Nothing changes for runners until the morning of the run.
